title: New UK cost of living crisis looms with soaring energy bills forecast to lift inflation

paragraphs.en: British households are facing a renewed cost of living squeeze, with official figures expected to show this week that soaring energy bills drove up inflation in July to close to 3%.
paragraphs.zh: 英国家庭正面临新一轮生活成本压力，本周公布的官方数据预计将显示，能源账单飙升推动7月通胀升至接近3%。

paragraphs.en: As the Iran war continues to send shock waves through global energy markets, economists predict the surge in UK gas and electricity bills last month will push Britain’s headline inflation rate to 2.9%.
paragraphs.zh: 随着伊朗战争继续冲击全球能源市场，经济学家预测，上月英国燃气费和电费的飙升将把英国整体通胀率推高至2.9%。

paragraphs.en: In a fresh squeeze on household budgets, the figures from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) due on Wednesday are forecast to show a jump from a rate of 2.6% in June.
paragraphs.zh: 这将对家庭预算造成新的压力。预计英国国家统计局（ONS）将于周三公布的数据将显示，通胀率从6月的2.6%跃升。

paragraphs.en: The Bank of England is considering raising interest rates from as early as September in response to fears over stubbornly high inflation becoming entrenched in the economy.
paragraphs.zh: 由于担心居高不下的通胀在经济中根深蒂固，英国央行正考虑最早从9月开始加息。

paragraphs.en: Related: UK economy shows surprising resilience – but that might not last | Richard Partington
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：英国经济表现出惊人的韧性——但这可能不会持续｜理查德·帕廷顿（Richard Partington）

paragraphs.en: Reports also emerged overnight that the water regulator Ofwat was considering plans to impose “surge pricing” on water usage during droughts. It could see customers charged more for water use during summer and less in winter, or else charged higher prices when they pass a threshold of water use, according to the Daily Telegraph.
paragraphs.zh: 当晚还有报道称，水务监管机构Ofwat正在考虑在干旱期间对用水实施“高峰定价”的计划。据《每日电讯报》报道，这可能意味着客户在夏季用水要付更多钱，冬季付更少，或者在用水量超过某个门槛后支付更高价格。

paragraphs.en: The latest snapshot will highlight the challenge facing Andy Burnham’s government to ease the financial pressure on households and businesses before a difficult autumn budget.
paragraphs.zh: 这一最新数据将凸显安迪·伯纳姆政府面临的挑战：在秋季预算艰难出台之前，缓解家庭和企业面临的财政压力。

paragraphs.en: Economists said a rise in inflation as measured by the consumer prices index was likely after Ofgem, the energy regulator, lifted its cap on household gas and electricity bills by 13% in July.
paragraphs.zh: 经济学家表示，能源监管机构Ofgem于7月将家庭燃气和电费上限上调13%之后，以消费者价格指数衡量的通胀很可能上升。
